stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Construction with Recruiting Filter
stories.description: Implement query construction logic for ClinicalTrials.gov API including condition matching, location parameters, and strict enforcement of RECRUITING status filter to ensure only actionable trials are returned.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes
stories.description: Compute travel distance and duration from user location to each clinical trial site using Google Routes API, including batching and mapping results back to normalized trial locations.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Clinical Trials
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials search into EvaluateCare facade, orchestrating schema validation, service execution, and response formatting for downstream tool consumption.

stories.title: External API Error Handling and Graceful Degradation
stories.description: Implement error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API failures, including partial results handling (e.g., trials without distance) and safe fallbacks to maintain system responsiveness.
